skill.name: tavily-web

skill.summary: Adds Tavily-powered web research, extraction, and crawling guidance for AI assistants.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The skill is prompt-only and contains no executable implementation files. The static command and network findings are documentation artifacts in SKILL.md, with no evidence of automatic execution, exfiltration, or prompt injection.

finding_verdicts.reason: The flagged text is a Markdown bash fence containing an installation command, not Ruby backtick execution or executable skill code. No user-controlled command construction appears in SKILL.md.
The hardcoded URL is a documentation link to a GitHub repository. It is not an automatic network request and does not transmit user data.

content.user_title: Search and Research the Web with Tavily
content.value_statement: AI assistants often need current web context and clean source material. This skill guides Tavily search, extraction, crawling, and research tasks from Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Guides web searches for current information using Tavily.
Supports extracting readable content from supplied URLs.
Helps plan website crawling for research tasks.
Connects Tavily results to Claude Code conversations.
Documents API key setup through environment variables.
limitations: Requires a configured Tavily API key before use.
Depends on Tavily availability and account limits.
Does not include executable code or a local wrapper script.
Search quality depends on query specificity and source availability.

use_cases.title: Current Technical Research
use_cases.description: Find recent documentation, release notes, and implementation references before making code changes.

use_cases.title: Source Collection for Writing
use_cases.description: Gather web sources and extract page content for drafts, briefs, or documentation updates.

use_cases.title: Competitive and Product Research
use_cases.description: Search public pages and crawl selected sites to compare features, positioning, or pricing signals.

prompt_templates.title: Search for Current Facts
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Tavily to search for current information about [topic]. Summarize the key facts and include source links.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Page Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Tavily to extract readable content from these URLs: [URLs]. Summarize the relevant sections for [goal].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Multiple Sources
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Tavily to research [topic] across reputable sources. Compare claims, note disagreements, and cite the strongest sources.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Focused Crawl
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Tavily to crawl [site or section] for [research objective]. Extract relevant pages and organize findings by theme.

output_examples.input: Research the latest stable release notes for a framework before upgrading.
output_examples.output: A concise summary of release changes, migration risks, source links, and recommended follow-up checks.

output_examples.input: Extract product information from three competitor pages.
output_examples.output: A comparison of feature claims, pricing mentions, positioning themes, and cited page references.

output_examples.input: Crawl a documentation section for authentication setup guidance.
output_examples.output: A grouped overview of relevant pages, setup steps, configuration notes, and unresolved questions.

best_practices: Provide focused research questions and preferred source types.
Ask for citations when decisions depend on current facts.
Store Tavily credentials in environment variables, not prompts.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for broad web research without a clear decision goal.
Do not treat search summaries as verified facts without checking sources.
Do not paste API keys or private tokens into conversations.

faq.question: What does this skill add?
faq.answer: It guides Tavily-powered web search, content extraction, crawling, and research workflows for AI assistants.

faq.question: Does it require a Tavily account?
faq.answer: Yes. You need a Tavily API key configured before the assistant can use Tavily services.

faq.question: Can it browse live websites?
faq.answer: It is designed for current web search and extraction through Tavily, subject to Tavily access and limits.

faq.question: Is it compatible with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill describes use in Claude Code conversations and also lists Claude and Codex support.

faq.question: Does the skill include runnable code?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed package contains SKILL.md instructions only, with no executable implementation files.

faq.question: How should sources be handled?
faq.answer: Ask for source links and verify important claims before using results in decisions or published work.
